newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Auto parts manufacturers started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Auto parts manufacturers started.

text.p: Bear Stearns analyst Eric Goldstein confirmed on Tuesday that he initiated coverage of various automotive parts manufacturers.

-- Goldstein said he started coverage of Tower Automotive Inc with an attractive rating, because he believes the company could grow earnings at around 20 percent a year through a combination of internal growth and acquisitions.
-- Goldstein said he started coverage of Walbro Corp, Superior Industries International Inc, Magna International Inc and Lear Corp with neutral ratings.
-- "We are looking for smaller-capitalization names which haven't participated in the rally," he said. "Lear and Magna are close to fully valued."
-- Goldstein said he started coverage of Mascotech Inc and Standard Products Co with buy ratings, because these stocks still trade at large discounts to peers.
-- Standard Products is one of the better turnaround stories in the automotive industry, and its shares were trading at a 25 percent discount to its peer group, he said.
-- MascoTech is undervalued, and enjoys a leadership position in a variety of metal-working technologies, including hot and cold forgings, powdered metal forging and machining, Goldstein said.
-- Goldstein said his 12-month price target for Standard Products is $32 per share, while his target for MascoTech is $25 per share.
